ARGUMENT: From a welfare perspective, option B offers the best balance between maximizing net fiscal impact and addressing diverse needs. Prioritizing only humanitarian cases (A) risks exceeding budget constraints with lower economic returns, while option C’s focus on uncertain documentation may delay allocations and reduce overall efficiency. The estimated 10-year net fiscal impacts show Group H (+$40k) and S (+$25k) contribute positively, while C and U have negative impacts. Option C’s focus on uncertain documentation risks unfair exclusion without sufficient safeguards.
